stem: An analyst randomly splits 40 Voltmarkt stores into 20 test stores and 20 control stores. Before the test starts, the test stores' average weekly sales are 6% higher than the control stores'. What explains this?

options.text: The split cannot have been random, because random assignment always makes the groups identical
Random assignment balances groups only on average; with 20 stores each, chance gaps occur
Stores cannot be randomised; random assignment only works for individual customers
The test stores must have started the change early, since sales already differ
